study.question: Observed limitation: smaller summary tables alone did not improve measured cost. Round21 full_native and sparse_native have identical validation AUC 0.6203373141662112 and Logloss 0.1958900563741975; train seconds were 419.466765 and 423.479238, inference seconds 18.344567 and 18.725215. Full_analytic and sparse_analytic both reached AUC 0.6200344118940478, with native-versus-analytic feature error about 9.81e-8 and same-checkpoint head error around 1e-8; this is numerical sensitivity along one seed trajectory, not evidence of useful entropy dust. Layout equality held on the host diagnostic subset, not proven on every batch. Current parent source recomputes target matches in _membership, _match_counts and _identity_tables and invokes separate category/brand hash scatters and reductions. No profiler is exposed, so launch overhead is a hypothesis rather than an observed hardware bottleneck. Frozen joint_identity has AUC 0.6204259427647623, train 548.357978 seconds, inference 19.217596 seconds, 17159923 parameters and peak720559616 bytes; parent has17155911 parameters and peak392653312 bytes. Parent is lower cost with a single-seed AUC deficit0.0000886285985511, not established noninferiority. Multiple trajectories matter: initial compact_summary0.619129 versus capacity-matched0.619518, factorized fine recency0.619814 versus localized0.620284, support_only0.619712, global_summary0.620093 and target_excluded0.619607 all retain negative evidence against indiscriminate compression. Repeated deterministic replay outcomes are not independent seeds. Supplied trajectory index contains no failed training trials and previous_runtime_error is null; absence of failures here is not evidence all possible trials succeed. Prospective question: can partition reuse and packed independent-field count execution retain the same summaries and utility while lowering measured training/inference cost, and which execution change accounts for savings?
study.hypothesis: The next useful simplification is computational reuse rather than deleting history relationships. With table volume fixed, sharing exact match counts and batching independent field consumers may remove redundant operations or launches while preserving native summary values, parameters and the learned function. Predictive utility and speed remain unmeasured hypotheses. This is an execution study of an already mechanism-distinct compressed model, not a new predictive architecture or an event-binding explanation.

nearest_work.difference: Closest executable reference. Reuse partition/count consumers and pack two field distributions; no feature family, information, trainable capacity, estimator, arithmetic convention, optimizer or loss change.

Frozen quality anchor retains learned content pooling, field moments/readouts and exact joint identity statistics. Proposed cells inherit the established content-off, fine-recency, product-marginal sketch alternative; this round does not reattribute all historical simplifications.

DIN uses learned candidate-conditioned activation over event embeddings and explicitly relaxes softmax normalization. Local baseline uses category/brand substitutions and normalized attention, so is an adaptation. Our counts use exact target-field match partitions and fixed hash-distribution summaries without learned event scoring. No novelty/priority or exact DIN reproduction claim.

Author README confirms only category/brand/type behavior data, no item histories. Full publisher text remains unavailable in the authorized source, so detailed DMR mechanism and novelty relative to it are unresolved; no missing item identity is invented.

Organizer describes packed attention views for QueryFormer and shared sequence embeddings for UniDot. Generic reuse/packing overlaps conceptually; this study only counts fixed categorical distributions and changes no attention/query/highway architecture. Detailed participant implementations are not checked. These are external reports on a different task, not local evidence or priority verification.

inherited_components: All 22 retained methods including the exact initializer from g2-r0021-full_native.
Static embeddings, action/recency embeddings and fixed capacity-matched MLP, plus zero-initialized bias-free 28->16->1 identity head.
Four match groups, log-count action-age histogram, group-local fine recency, 256-bin salt0 category/brand concentration and independent product summaries.
Full native table arithmetic, all visible events and missing/padding rules; frozen host data/scorer/optimizer/training contracts.
study.proposed_difference: 2x2 execution-only intervention: share_partition replaces three redundant target-match classifications with one partition used by base/identity consumers, deriving the same integer counts from four group sizes. pack_fields replaces two independent Bx4x256 hash table operations with a Bx2x4x256 operation whose last-axis reductions remain per field/group. No distributions merge and table volume stays constant. Same Model AST/config switches and parameter initialization across cells; no cache crosses forward calls. No claim of novel prediction information or proven hardware bottleneck.
predictions: At the same checkpoint, shared and packed features/identity/logits should be strictly equal to legacy in host diagnostics; any nonzero error falsifies strict numerical equivalence on that subset. Independent dense hashed-equality oracle error should remain <=1e-6, the parent scale being about2.94e-7.

If redundant execution is consequential, a faithful cell should reduce full train or validation inference seconds by at least3% relative to the concurrent replay, with no p95 latency regression above3% and no peak-memory increase above5%. Treat one timing as exploratory and repeat the selected comparison before claiming robust savings. Do not substitute theoretical table/kernel counts for measured cost.

Predeclared practical utility criterion for final paired-seed validation: mean candidate-minus-replay AUC>=-0.0001, mean candidate-minus-frozen-joint_identity AUC>=-0.0002, and mean Logloss increase<=0.0001 against each. These are provisional engineering margins set before these executions, not statistically established noninferiority. Seek paired user-cluster intervals if host interface supplies them; never manufacture significance when predictions/bootstrap are unavailable.

Packing and partition reuse may interact; report all four cells, each single-factor contrast and the difference of differences for cost. If values are strictly equal but seed42 AUC differs, checkpoint/training nondeterminism needs investigation, not a representation explanation.
falsifiers: Any same-checkpoint feature/identity/logit mismatch rejects strict execution equivalence for that batch, even if AUC improves. AUC equality alone is insufficient.
No repeatable >=3% measured training/inference reduction, or a material latency/memory regression, rejects the corresponding implementation as an efficiency improvement.
Paired-seed practical utility margins fail, or unquantified seed/cluster uncertainty spans consequential losses: do not claim retained utility.
Larger packed temporaries, allocator pressure or count kernels offset saved launches; reject the hardware-overhead explanation for this implementation while retaining the existing summary model.
alternative_explanations: Table reduction dominated less than feature gathering, sparse embeddings or MLP updates; packing may be irrelevant to end-to-end cost.
Packed tensors change numerical kernel choices despite mathematically identical reductions, and tiny perturbations can change the full training path as round21 showed.
Wall-time jitter or selected checkpoint changes mimic a speed/quality effect; repetitions and concurrent replay are necessary.
Source motifs of packing/reuse are generic; neither success nor failure tests the external query-generation, transport or highway mechanisms.

The compressed parent remains below frozen joint_identity in one-seed AUC, and utility margins/selection across many trials create uncertainty. Success here would not establish event binding or universal history compressibility.
